set.body:
Follow-ups from the cold review of S3a (12be5fa6d), deferred from the fix commit:
1. Visual origin accepts anchors on Audio streams (Track is allowed on Audio). Visual mentions should require a Picture stream; the factory needs the SourceBundle (stream kinds) to check it, so SimultaneousTracks cannot then separate two overlapping speaker tracks.
2. ProperName folds by lowercasing and whitespace only: no Unicode normalization (NFC/NFD) and no partial-name handling ("Ana" vs "Ana Smith"); DifferentNames then licenses a sufficient distinctness that opens a class. Names are caller-asserted and not tied to the support. Decide normalization (portable across JVM/JS/Native) and whether DifferentNames should require full-name equality classes.
3. The same-stream guard for ContinuousTrack is unwitnessed: a two-picture-stream film bundle cannot be built outside core (SourceBundle.computeId is private[core]). Add a public test fixture in core, or witness it in S3c.
4. Deixis counts mentions, not referents (two mentions of one person refuse, fail-closed), and assumes the context lists everyone present; S3c must state detection completeness before deixis is admitted.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3a follow-ups] Picture-only visual origin, name normalization, stream-guard witness, deixis completeness
